review.availability: Reviewed both official opener packets and Kansas State's November2 coach availability. review.countercase: K-State has home court and the higher-end size/talent. JT Rock is expected to play after limited exhibition health. SDSU also has eight newcomers. The unadjusted baseline favors K-State by about14; this desk pick differs because current backcourt continuity and unsettled K-State roles matter more to my opening-night assessment. This is not a quantified EV claim.
